non_idle_rule: After every result or interruption, immediately analyze, log, and launch the next experiment. The watchdog recovers only declared queued workers. When the queue is empty, the primary Codex process must plan and enqueue the next experiments. Wait only for an active process, active Codex planning, or required external operation. Stop only on exact top-level STOP.
current_hypothesis: The strongest measured Qwen checkpoint may benefit from complementary encoder predictions. Screen fixed probability blends, confidence and disagreement rules, class-specialist routes, and visible-input routes on a deterministic clean SFT-source sample capped at 500 rows before selecting a test candidate.
experiment_queue: Screen the fixed encoder fusion and routing candidates on the clean train_sft validation sample capped at 500 rows, using outputs/qwen-when2call-fullpool-base-seed20261055/epoch-02 and the frozen Jina encoder. Select by validation accuracy only.

Freeze the validation-winning ensemble method and measure it on the full aggregate-only black-box test set against the paired Qwen checkpoint and encoder. Do not use aggregate test metrics to select or tune methods.

If the fixed ensemble screen improves clean validation, test a small regularized fusion model trained on a disjoint part of the capped clean source sample and evaluated on the remaining part. Keep all partitions at or below 500 rows and select by validation accuracy.

If the ensemble methods fail to improve clean validation, resume individual-model exploration with a fresh regularization trial on all 9,000 When2Call rows. Evaluate training and clean validation probes of at most 500 examples and the full test in aggregate. Stop using clean validation accuracy only.
last_action: Queued a corrected clean-validation ensemble screen after the first attempt exposed a CPU/GPU mask mismatch.

best_observed_test.selection: Fixed two-epoch run. Aggregate test result is report-only and was not used for checkpoint selection.

next_hypothesis: A stronger full-pool Qwen checkpoint may gain from complementary encoder predictions; use a capped clean train_sft sample to select a simple fusion rule before any new black-box measurement.

post_queue_report_required.trigger: After the current clean-validation screen and its selected aggregate test measurement.
post_queue_report_required.contents: Report each fixed ensemble candidate on the same capped clean-validation sample, the chosen frozen method on full aggregate test, the paired Qwen and encoder baselines, and limitations. State that test metrics were report-only.
post_queue_report_required.selection: Select and freeze candidates with clean validation accuracy only. Never use black-box test labels or aggregate test scores to select or tune.

future_policy.continuation_metric: Clean held-out validation accuracy when validation is available.
future_policy.stop_rule: Stop at the first epoch where clean held-out validation accuracy does not improve. If validation is omitted by explicit direction, follow its fixed schedule.
future_policy.reported_metrics: Training accuracy and macro F1 from at most 500 deterministic random training examples; held-out validation accuracy and macro F1 from at most 500 examples; aggregate black-box test accuracy and macro F1 from the full test set.
future_policy.test_metrics_use: Aggregate report only, never use test labels or per-example outcomes for selection.

open_ended_phase: Explore encoder plus strongest Qwen SFT fusion first. Compare fixed blends, confidence and disagreement gating, class routes, visible-input routes, and then a regularized validation-trained stacker if fixed fusion improves validation. If no ensemble helps clean validation, return to controlled individual Qwen training changes.

duplicate_worker_failure.reason: Shared heartbeat.tmp collision while duplicate command targeted the same output directory. No checkpoint or evaluation was saved.

stopped_experiment.reason: User requested stopping the active run and clearing the queue before continuing ensemble exploration.

queue_cleared_reason: The user requested that the active experiment and pending queue be stopped and cleared before further exploration. The queue now contains only the clean-validation ensemble screen.

failed_experiment.failure: A visible-input routing mask was created on CUDA while cached probability tensors were on CPU. The evaluator failed before writing validation metrics. No black-box test data was loaded.
